notes: Fresh original-only extraction from the published scanned article. Title and authors match the supplied reference. Target page/table checked visually against the PDF because OCR is imperfect. The supplied p.5 locator is PDF p.5, published p.506; Table 2 is on PDF p.6, published p.507. The average comparison target in Study 2 is specifically the average college student, rather than an unspecified average person. Table 2 prints F = 6.71 and p < .01 for the omnibus between-target univariate analysis; that F is not the requested personal-versus-average-student paired comparison and is therefore not entered as its statistic. The paired comparison is represented by the average-student mean difference and its two-asterisk p bound; its numerical t statistic is not printed. No effect-size conversion performed. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
